source_unit.label: Special Digivolution Condition
source_unit.text: [DNA Digivolution] Red Lv.4 + yellow Lv.4: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolution] Red Lv.4 + yellow Lv.4: Cost 0 Digivolve unsuspended with the 2 specified Digimon stacked on top of each other.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text:
＜Partition (red Lv.4 & yellow Lv.4)＞
[When Digivolving] If DNA digivolving, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -7000 DP until the end of their turn.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Partition (red Lv.4 & yellow Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your effects or a battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
